scenes.title: The sound of a sole

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The street wakes before the sun has finished deciding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: From the repair shop comes a peculiar rhythm: scrape, step, flap.

beats.speaker: delivery_worker
beats.text: Please tell me that sound is the door.

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: That sole won't survive tomorrow's deliveries. I can show you what to look for—but you'll have to decide what to do.

choices.label: Visit the free Career Development Office first

scenes.accessibilitySummary: Repair-shop exterior, a delivery worker standing with a separated shoe sole, Tomas near the doorway. All dialogue as text.

beats.speaker: delivery_worker
beats.text: The front lifts whenever I step down.

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: Good eyes are useful. Careful questions are better. Ask what happened before choosing a fix.

scenes.title: The cost of a missed morning

beats.speaker: delivery_worker
beats.text: I have deliveries tomorrow. I can't afford to promise what my shoes won't let me do.

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: Then we should be clear about the risk, not just the repair.

scenes.title: A door that stays open
scenes.transition: Transit required; no instantaneous teleport; resume at repair shop by player choice

beats.speaker: counselor
beats.text: You can explore work beyond your degree. Guidance here is free.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A note in the local opportunities list points back to a repair shop in the Residential Area.

scenes.travelDuration: unspecified; governed by world travel system

scenes.title: The shop is not just a shop
scenes.trigger: player returns to shop after chosen branch

beats.speaker: mira_solen
beats.text: Tomas, the bakery's delivery cart is still waiting on that wheel.

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: And I am still waiting on a second pair of hands.

beats.speaker: mira_solen
beats.text: That's the trouble with this street. Everyone needs you. Nobody asks how long you can keep going.

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: I haven't decided to retire. I've decided I can't do this forever.

choices.label: Ask Tomas to teach you the inspection
Ask Mira what else the street needs

scenes.title: A promise small enough to keep

beats.speaker: tomas_vale
beats.text: We start with the shoes. Not the whole street. One thing done carefully.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The repair bench is open. You can try the inspection now, or return later.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You haven't saved the street. You've learned where to begin.

originFlavor.line: You notice how many repairs carry someone's personal history.
You recognize the value of keeping working tools in use.
You wonder how the shop tracks jobs when every customer arrives at once.
You ask whether walking in damaged shoes has been causing pain.

acceptance.test: All three opening choices converge without career lock
Counselor route uses real transit and free service
Declining quest does not block other play
All four origins receive flavor only, same available choices
No monetary events from dialogue flags
Panel text accessible, captions and choice labels separate from art
Story does not grant competence absent quest evidence
